title: Scanning the chain.
style: Blending Pacific Māori ceremonial style with old school hip hop, the track opens with deep booming pahu and Vanuatu slit log drums under a swung poi groove in 4/4. Ukulele brings warmth, as haka spoken word sections in te reo Māori trade off with punchy English choruses. Layered body-percussion forms a dynamic 3-group polyrhythm, infusing haka energy and physical intensity. The oceanic atmosphere is vast, integrating wave-like ambient textures. The arrangement builds to a powerful “final signal” section with robust group vocals, uniting the percussive force and hip hop breakbeats in a compelling finale.
lyrics:
[Intro – female vocoder, filtered, then opening up]  
Scanning the chain.  
Two hundred and fifty indicators.  
Two hundred plus indicators online.  
One question, one mission:  
Data… or noise?  
Stay grounded in data, not noise.

[Verse 1 – male, conversational then locked in]  
Tom. Particle physics degree,  
Long-haul pilot brain at thirty thousand feet.  
Used to reading instruments inside a storm of rain,  
Now he points that lens at every Bitcoin trade and pain.  

Land the plane, open the laptop,  
Bitcoin chart, coffee, full stop.  
Tired of analysts drawing random lines,  
Justifying calls with made-up signs.  

The market screams stories every new day,  
But on-chain flows tell it a different way.  
Headlines flip from euphoria to pain,  
He’s counting who is bleeding on-chain.  

When will the pain stop? Not when tweets say so,  
When the cohort under water starts letting go.  
Price is just surface, stress is underneath,  
Time spent below cost is the pain in their teeth.

[Hook – male + female vocoder]  
Is it data, or noise?  
Is it signal, or just another voice?  
Same chart, two different poise,  
On-Chain Mind cuts through the toys.  
Data, not noise,  
That’s the tool, not just a choice.  
If you’re tired of the guessing boys,  
Tune in calm, On-Chain Mind.

[Verse 2 – male, faster]  
A guy on YouTube said the bottom’s in,  
Drew a line on a chart, called it a win.  
Meanwhile the on-chain data said wait,  
Smart money moving at a different rate.  

Hundred days trading under recent buy,  
Reactive investors asking “how low, why?”  
Capitulation zones, Ω‑Score low,  
Deep drawdown… but what does that show?  

Two fifty indicators, not a guess,  
Cycle framework under all the stress.  
Time is a catalyst, not just the fall,  
Bear markets end when exhaustion hits all.  

From “How Low Can Bitcoin Go?” to “Violent move ahead,”  
He doesn’t sell fear, he just shows you what was said  
by the chain itself — holders, flows,  
Long-term supply waking up, or letting go.

[Short ad‑lib – female vocoder, panned]  
No es drama, es estructura.  
Não é hype, é leitura.

[Chorus – blend of Hook + Chorus]  
We got two readings, on-chain and off,  
One sees the signal, one sees the froth.  
Same market, two different takes,  
On-Chain Mind, we catch your mistakes.  

Is it data, or noise?  
Same chart, two different poise,  
On-Chain Mind cuts through the toys.  

[Verse 3 – male, deadpan → legendary]  
A violent move is coming, he said it calm,  
No CAPS LOCK, no alarm.  
Just a chart, a cycle map, a clean take,  
Here’s the data… make your own mistake.  

Seven thousand readers, but it feels like one room,  
Serious minds asking “bear or boom?”  
Six thousand nine hundred users found him,  
Thirty thousand subs surround him.  

Not because he hypes the number up,  
Because he fills the serious analyst cup.  
Two models, one question: what’s Bitcoin worth?  
Not hopium lines, but work under the dirt.  

DCA, lump sum, what fits your plan?  
He shows the framework, you’re still the one who stands.  
He’s not here to tell you “buy now, all in,”  
He’s here to show regime, where trend might begin.

[Bridge – male, very calm, instruments drop]  
No hype. No guesswork.  
Just a pilot reading instruments.  
Same sky. Different altitude.  
Just charts and context.  
On-chain data. Full stop.  
Bear or bull, the data speaks,  
If you listen long enough.

[Final Hook – group, anthemic]  
Data, or noise?  
Signal, or voice?  
Same chart, different poise,  
On-Chain Mind cuts through the toys.  

Data, not noise,  
Teach you how to think, not rejoice.  
If you value truth over chase,  
Welcome to the On-Chain space.

[Outro – male + female vocoder, call‑and‑response]  
Onchainmind dot io, data or noise,  
Two hundred fifty metrics, zero hype deployed.  
Tom built it clean, Tom built it right,  
On-Chain Mind, still on, every night.  

Onchainmind dot io.  
When will the pain stop?  
The chain will tell you.  

On. Chain. Mind.  
Data. Not noise.
